activity.disconnected.source: 活动连接中断，恢复后自动续读。
activity.disconnected.translation: Activity is disconnected. Updates will resume when the connection returns.

activity.empty.source: 此评审空间暂无操作记录。
activity.empty.translation: No operations in this review space yet.

activity.open.translation: Open annotation in a new window

activity.recent.source: 共享评审空间的最近操作；不会改变当前播放。
activity.recent.translation: Recent operations in this shared review space. Playback is unchanged.

activity.retryOrPickAnother.source: 请重试或选择其他片源

activity.stillWorking.source: 仍在处理，可取消或选择其他视频
activity.stillWorking.translation: Still working; you can cancel or pick another video

activity.trackDetails.source: 查看轨道 {slot} 的上屏信息

admin.analysisResourceHelp.source: 设置所有用户共享的服务端分析并发数。默认 8 路，可设为 1–32 路；并发越高，CPU 和内存占用越大。保存后立即生效，调低不会中断正在运行的任务。
admin.analysisResourceHelp.translation: Set server analysis concurrency shared by all users. Default: 8; range: 1–32. Higher concurrency uses more CPU and memory. Changes take effect immediately; lowering the limit lets running tasks finish.

admin.analysisResourceStatus.source: 当前上限 {limit} 路 · {running} 项运行中 · {queued} 项排队

admin.cacheBudget.source: {used} / {limit} 上限 · 达到上限后自动清理旧缓存
admin.cacheBudget.translation: {used} / {limit} limit · Old caches are cleared automatically at the limit

admin.cacheDesc.source: 查看占用，清理可重新生成的数据。
admin.cacheDesc.translation: Storage use; clean up data that regenerates.

admin.cachesCount.translation: {n, plural, one {# cached item} other {# cached items}}

admin.capNote.translation: Stops at whichever cap hits first.

admin.clearAllFrames.source: 清理全部帧索引？保留视频文件。
admin.clearAllFrames.translation: Clear all frame indexes? Video files are kept.

admin.clearAllPreviews.source: 清理全部标注预览？保留标注内容。
admin.clearAllPreviews.translation: Clear all annotation previews? Annotation content is kept.

admin.clearAllThumbnails.source: 清理全部媒体缩略图？保留视频文件，仅删小图。清理后从头打开可重建。
admin.clearAllThumbnails.translation: Clear all media thumbnails? Video files are kept. Thumbnails are rebuilt when you open videos from the start.

admin.countLine.source: {done} 次完成 · {errors, plural, other {# 次错误}} · {pending} 次处理中
admin.countLine.translation: {done} done · {errors, plural, one {# error} other {# errors}} · {pending} active

admin.cpuCaption.source: CPU 以一个逻辑核为 100%。连接数包含浏览器保持的空闲连接。
admin.cpuCaption.translation: CPU is percent of one logical core. Connections include idle browser keep-alives.

admin.deleteLogConfirm.source: 从服务器删除这份日志？此操作无法撤销。
admin.deleteLogConfirm.translation: Delete this log from the server? This cannot be undone.

admin.deleteWsConfirm.source: 删除服务器工作区？不删除视频或已打开的会话。
admin.deleteWsConfirm.translation: Delete the server workspace? Videos and open sessions stay.

admin.descConcurrent.source: 浏览器同时读取四路媒体，统计合计吞吐。包含文件读取、网络、缓存和浏览器调度。
admin.descConcurrent.translation: The browser reads four media streams at once and totals throughput. Includes reads, network, caches, and browser scheduling.

admin.descDownload.source: 服务器 → 浏览器，传输内存数据，不读取媒体文件。
admin.descDownload.translation: Server → browser, in-memory data, no media files read.

admin.descPreviews.source: 标注卡片使用的画面预览。清理保留文字和绘图，再次编辑对应画面时生成。
admin.descPreviews.translation: Image previews for mark cards. Text and drawings are kept; regenerates while editing that frame.

admin.descStorage.source: 服务器重复读取所选媒体。包含系统缓存，不代表磁盘物理带宽。
admin.descStorage.translation: The server re-reads the selected media. Includes OS caches, not physical disk bandwidth.

admin.descThumbs.source: 媒体库首帧小图。清理后只在正常从头打开时重建，不主动解码。
admin.descThumbs.translation: First-frame thumbnails for the library. Rebuilds only on plain reopening, never by proactive decoding.

admin.descUpload.source: 当前浏览器 → 服务器。单路上传随机数据，收到后即丢弃，不保存到磁盘。
admin.descUpload.translation: This browser → server. One stream of random uploads, discarded on receipt, never stored.

admin.dirHelp.source: 填写服务器上的完整路径。移除目录不会删除原文件。
admin.dirHelp.translation: Enter the full path on the server. Removing a directory does not delete files.

admin.dirsSavedNotice.source: 媒体目录已保存，后台开始校准索引。
admin.dirsSavedNotice.translation: Media directories saved; background index calibration started.

admin.emptyPreviews.source: 编辑标注后，画面预览会在播放暂停时保存。
admin.emptyPreviews.translation: Edit a mark and its frame preview is saved on pause.

admin.emptyThumbs.source: 从头打开媒体库视频后，首帧小图会保存在这里。
admin.emptyThumbs.translation: Open a library video from the start and its first-frame thumbnail lands here.

admin.errorAccess.source: 操作未获授权。请从服务器的同源页面重试。
admin.errorAccess.translation: This action is not authorized. Retry from a page on the server’s origin.

admin.errorConflict.source: 内容已改变。请载入最新版本后重试；你的草稿仍保留。
admin.errorConflict.translation: The content has changed. Load the latest version and retry; your draft is preserved.

admin.errorInvalid.source: 请求无法处理。请检查输入和当前版本后重试。
admin.errorInvalid.translation: The request could not be processed. Check your input and the current version, then retry.

admin.errorMissing.source: 内容已不存在。请刷新列表后重试。
admin.errorMissing.translation: The content no longer exists. Refresh the list and retry.

admin.errorSize.source: 提交内容过大。请减少数据量后重试。
admin.errorSize.translation: The submitted content is too large. Reduce its size and retry.

admin.errorUnavailable.source: 无法完成请求。请检查连接与服务状态后重试。
admin.errorUnavailable.translation: The request could not be completed. Check the connection and service, then retry.

admin.framesDescription.source: 加快媒体库视频再次打开和定位。支持的 FFmpeg 容器由服务端重建索引；FLV 仍在播放时重建。
admin.framesDescription.translation: Open library videos and seek faster. The server rebuilds indexes for supported FFmpeg containers; FLV indexes are rebuilt during playback.

admin.framesEmpty.source: 打开支持的媒体库视频后，索引会自动保存在这里。
admin.framesEmpty.translation: Indexes are saved here automatically when you open supported library videos.

admin.libraryDesc.source: 添加服务器目录，保存后即可在播放器中浏览视频。
admin.libraryDesc.translation: Add server directories, then browse videos in the player after saving.

admin.logPlaceholder.source: 日志内容会显示在这里

admin.logsDesc.source: 查看用户上传的诊断日志，或检查服务器收到的请求。
admin.logsDesc.translation: Uploaded diagnostic logs, or requests received by the server.

admin.logsEmptyHint.source: 在播放器的“设置 → 日志”中点击“上传日志”，即可在这里查看。
admin.logsEmptyHint.translation: In the player, open “Settings → Logs” and click “Upload logs” to see them here.

admin.logsNoDir.source: 服务器未设置日志接收目录。你仍可在播放器中下载本地日志。
admin.logsNoDir.translation: The server has no log directory configured. You can still download local logs in the player.

admin.marksDesc.source: 检索评审记录，恢复已删除的标注。
admin.marksDesc.translation: Search review records and restore deleted marks.

admin.measureBusyError.source: 已有测速任务。请等待完成，或取消当前任务后重试。
admin.measureBusyError.translation: A speed test is already running. Wait for it to finish, or cancel the current test and retry.

admin.measureDesc.source: 选择测试类型和上限，再点击“开始测试”。
admin.measureDesc.translation: Pick a test type and caps, then click “Start test”.

admin.measureFinishError.source: 当前读取仍在结束。请稍等片刻再提交测量结果。
admin.measureFinishError.translation: The current reads are still finishing. Wait a moment before submitting the measurement result.

admin.measureFinishing.source: 正在结束，等待当前读取释放
admin.measureFinishing.translation: Finishing, waiting for reads to release

admin.measureMediaError.source: 媒体不可读或版本已改变。请重新选择当前可读的非空媒体。
admin.measureMediaError.translation: The media is unreadable or its version has changed. Select a readable, nonempty media file again.

admin.noMatchWs.source: 没有找到匹配的工作区

admin.noReadErrors.source: 本次扫描没有读取错误
admin.noReadErrors.translation: No read errors in this scan

admin.noReadableMedia.translation: No readable media on this page

admin.originBrowserTiming.source: 发起浏览器计时（含请求往返）

admin.originServerCount.source: 服务端计数；浏览器结果尚未提交
admin.originServerCount.translation: Server counting; browser result not submitted yet

admin.originServerRead.source: 服务端文件读取（含系统缓存）

admin.overviewDesc.source: 查看服务状态、资源占用和媒体扫描进度。
admin.overviewDesc.translation: Service status, resource usage, and media scan progress.

admin.pageCaption.source: 共 {total} 项 · 第 {n} 页，仅显示可读的非空文件
admin.pageCaption.translation: {total} items · page {n}, readable non-empty files only

admin.reasonUser.translation: Cancelled by user or connection lost

admin.recentRequests.source: 最近 200 条请求，服务重启后清空。

admin.removeDirTitle.source: 移出媒体库，不删除文件
admin.removeDirTitle.translation: Remove from the library, keep files

admin.requestsSummary.source: {done} 次完成 · {active} 次处理中 · {aborted} 次中断

admin.resourceNote.source: 测试期间会占用网络或存储资源。
admin.resourceNote.translation: Testing uses network or storage resources.

admin.resultConditions.source: {concurrency} 路 · 最长 {seconds} 秒 · 上限 {limit} MiB · {date}
admin.resultConditions.translation: {concurrency} streams · Up to {seconds} seconds · {limit} MiB limit · {date}

admin.resultsHint.source: 完成测试后显示速度、传输量和耗时。
admin.resultsHint.translation: Speed, volume, and elapsed time appear after a run.

admin.rootCli.source: 当前根目录由 --folder 覆盖，请修改启动参数或改用配置文件。
admin.rootCli.translation: The current roots are overridden by --folder. Change the startup arguments or use a configuration file.

admin.rootExternal.source: 配置文件已被外部修改，请重启服务以重新载入。
admin.rootExternal.translation: The configuration file was changed externally. Restart the service to reload it.

admin.rootNoSource.source: 此服务未提供可写配置来源。
admin.rootNoSource.translation: This service has no writable configuration source.

admin.rootPermission.source: 配置所在目录不可写，请调整数据目录权限。
admin.rootPermission.translation: The configuration directory is not writable. Adjust the data directory permissions.

admin.rootsSummary.source: {n, plural, other {# 个目录}} · {o} 个离线
admin.rootsSummary.translation: {n, plural, one {# directory} other {# directories}} · {o} offline

admin.saveCopy.translation: Save the current version as a copy

admin.savedAsCopy.source: 已另存为当前用户的副本。

admin.scanActive.source: 扫描中 · {visited, plural, other {# 个目录}}
admin.scanActive.translation: Scanning · {visited, plural, one {# directory} other {# directories}}

admin.scanDesc.source: 目录变化会自动更新；找不到新增视频时，可重新扫描。
admin.scanDesc.translation: Directory changes update automatically; rescan when new videos are missing.

admin.scanDetailOk.source: 目录离线时保留已有视频索引。
admin.scanDetailOk.translation: Offline directories keep their existing video index.

admin.scanDetailPartial.source: 部分目录无法读取，请检查下方路径或网络挂载。
admin.scanDetailPartial.translation: Some directories are unreadable. Check the paths or network mounts below.

admin.scanErrors.translation: {count, plural, one {# read error} other {# read errors}}{truncated}

admin.scanProgressLine.source: {state} · {visited, plural, other {# 个目录}} · {files} 个媒体
admin.scanProgressLine.translation: {state} · {visited, plural, one {# directory} other {# directories}} · {files} media

admin.searchMediaMark.source: 搜索媒体、标注或评审空间
admin.searchMediaMark.translation: Search media, marks, or review spaces

admin.selectLog.source: 选择一份日志查看内容

admin.selectToView.source: 选择一个工作区查看详情

admin.serverChanged.source: 服务器内容已改变，未覆盖任何修改。
admin.serverChanged.translation: Server content changed; nothing was overwritten.

admin.serviceDesc.source: 可信内网模式：用户名用于内容归属，不是身份认证。访问者可选择已有身份并使用管理功能；本服务不提供安全的多租户隔离。
admin.serviceDesc.translation: Trusted-intranet mode: user names attribute content, they are not authentication. Visitors may pick an existing identity and use admin features; this service does not provide secure multi-tenant isolation.

admin.sharedDb.source: 与业务数据共用数据库。清理后空间可复用，文件不一定缩小。
admin.sharedDb.translation: Shares the database with operational data. Space is reusable after cleanup; the file may not shrink.

admin.sourceRandom.source: 随机内存数据，不写入磁盘
admin.sourceRandom.translation: Random in-memory data, never written to disk

admin.trashConfirm.source: 将这条标注移入回收站？

admin.tryOtherNames.source: 试试其他名称，或清空搜索。
admin.tryOtherNames.translation: Try other names, or clear the search.

admin.waitStable.source: 等待媒体写入稳定或扫描完成…
admin.waitStable.translation: Waiting for media writes or the scan to settle…

admin.workspaceRow.source: {owner} · {tracks, plural, other {# 条轨道}} · {marks, plural, other {# 个标注}}
admin.workspaceRow.translation: {owner} · {tracks, plural, one {# track} other {# tracks}} · {marks, plural, one {# annotation} other {# annotations}}

admin.wsDesc.source: 打开已保存的评审，或修改名称、下载副本。
admin.wsDesc.translation: Open a saved review, or rename it and download a copy.

admin.wsEmptyHint.source: 在播放器的“设置 → 工作区”中点击“保存到服务器”，即可在这里打开和管理。
admin.wsEmptyHint.translation: In the player, open “Settings → Workspaces” and click “Save to server” to manage them here.

admin.wsMetaLine.source: 版本 {rev} · {tracks, plural, other {# 条轨道}} · {marks, plural, other {# 个标注}}
admin.wsMetaLine.translation: Revision {rev} · {tracks, plural, one {# track} other {# tracks}} · {marks, plural, one {# mark} other {# marks}}

analysis.bitrateLegendHint.source: 码率 · 实线；点击切换，右键或长按单选，再次操作恢复。
analysis.bitrateLegendHint.translation: Bitrate · solid line; click to toggle, right-click or hold to solo, repeat to restore.

analysis.bitrateWindowTitle.source: 码率窗口：视频样本负载码率的滑动时间窗（真实时间窗，非 N 帧窗）
analysis.bitrateWindowTitle.translation: Bitrate window: sliding window for sample payload bitrate (a real time window, not an N-frame window)

analysis.canvasLabel.source: 码流分析图：码率曲线与帧大小柱。方向键移动检查位置，回车定位，Escape 退出检查。
analysis.canvasLabel.translation: Bitstream plot: bitrate curve and frame-size bars. Arrow keys move the inspection point, Enter seeks, Escape exits inspection.

analysis.containerMixedHint.source: 也出现在逐帧 NALU 中

analysis.containerNaluHint.source: 不计入逐帧 NALU 和帧大小。
analysis.containerNaluHint.translation: Excluded from frame NALU and frame size totals.

analysis.currentFrameNumbersEmpty.source: 当前上屏帧号：尚未载入视频
analysis.currentFrameNumbersEmpty.translation: Current on-screen frame numbers: no video loaded

analysis.decodeBitrateWindowHint.source: 码率：按解码时间窗口统计压缩样本负载，不表示网络吞吐。
analysis.decodeBitrateWindowHint.translation: Bitrate: compressed sample payload within a decode-time window; not network throughput.

analysis.diagramDetailEvicted.source: 当前范围保留了汇总；重新检查可恢复逐帧细节。
analysis.diagramDetailEvicted.translation: This range retains summaries; check again to restore per-frame details.

analysis.diagramReferencesUnsupported.source: 这些帧没有可用的参考记录。需要支持参考列表的分析内核。
analysis.diagramReferencesUnsupported.translation: These pictures have no usable reference records. A core supporting reference lists is required.

analysis.diagramSoloHint.source: 点击切换；右键或长按单选，再次操作同一图表恢复之前的选择。
analysis.diagramSoloHint.translation: Click to toggle; right-click or long-press to show only this chart. Repeat on the same chart to restore your previous selection.

analysis.diagramUnanalyzed.source: 此范围尚未收到检查结果。
analysis.diagramUnanalyzed.translation: No inspection results received for this range yet.

analysis.editTrackFrameNumber.translation: Track {slot} {axis} frame number; activate to edit

analysis.emptyAllHidden.source: 已全部隐藏，请在工具条中选择要对比的轨道。
analysis.emptyAllHidden.translation: All hidden; pick tracks to compare in the toolbar.

analysis.emptyNoVideo.source: 尚未载入视频。载入后可在此检查码率与帧大小走向。
analysis.emptyNoVideo.translation: No video loaded yet. Load one to inspect bitrate and frame-size trends here.

analysis.enterFrameNumber.source: 输入轨道 {slot} 的{axis}帧号后按回车跳转
analysis.enterFrameNumber.translation: Type the {axis} frame number of track {slot}, then press Enter to seek

analysis.frameNumberMustBeNonNegativeInt.translation: The frame number must be a non-negative integer.

analysis.frameTitleBase.source: 轨道 {slot} 上屏帧：会话 PTS {pts}（{ptsUs} µs）
analysis.frameTitleBase.translation: Track {slot} on-screen frame: session PTS {pts} ({ptsUs} µs)

analysis.frameTitleDtsMissing.source: · DTS序 —（解码 PTS 不在包表内，不猜测）
analysis.frameTitleDtsMissing.translation: · DTS order — (decode PTS is not in the packet table; no guessing)

analysis.hoverDetailMissing.source: 此时间没有逐帧检查记录。
analysis.hoverDetailMissing.translation: No per-frame inspection record at this time.

analysis.inferredLayerHint.source: 按相邻 I/P 锚帧间的局部参考关系推断，不代表码流标记的时间层。* 表示参考信息不完整。
analysis.inferredLayerHint.translation: Inferred from local references between consecutive I/P anchors, not a signaled temporal layer. * indicates incomplete reference information.

analysis.inferredLayerPartial.source: 推断层级（参考信息不完整）

analysis.invalidRange.source: 请输入片源范围内的起止时间，结束时间须晚于起始时间。
analysis.invalidRange.translation: Enter times within the source range, with the end after the start.

analysis.missingDts.source: 所选轨道缺少可靠 DTS，无法按解码时间显示。
analysis.missingDts.translation: The selected tracks lack reliable DTS and cannot be displayed by decode time.

analysis.multiTrackLayoutTitle.source: 只影响码率和帧大小；NALU 与帧参考始终按轨道分开显示。
analysis.multiTrackLayoutTitle.translation: Applies only to bitrate and frame size. NALU and frame references always use separate tracks.

analysis.naluFilterEmpty.source: 没有选中 NALU 类型。点击图例或“全部”恢复显示。
analysis.naluFilterEmpty.translation: No NALU types selected. Click a legend item or “All” to show them again.

analysis.naluLegend.source: 横轴为时间 · 大小不含长度前缀 · 点击图例筛选，点击帧定位。
analysis.naluLegend.translation: Horizontal axis: time · Sizes exclude length prefixes · Click legend to filter, click frame to seek.

analysis.naluOverview.source: 汇总：每个时间段按选中类型显示平均帧大小与类型分布 · 放大查看逐帧细节。
analysis.naluOverview.translation: Summary: average frame size by selected type and type distribution per time interval · Zoom in for individual frames.

analysis.naluSizeCanvas.source: NALU 大小图。横轴为整片时间；放大查看逐帧大小。点击图例筛选类型，方向键选择，回车查看。
analysis.naluSizeCanvas.translation: NALU size chart. Horizontal axis: whole-source time; zoom in for per-frame sizes. Click legend to filter, arrow keys to select and Enter to inspect.

analysis.naluSoloHint.source: 点击切换筛选；右键或长按单选，再次操作恢复全部。
analysis.naluSoloHint.translation: Click to toggle filtering; right-click or long-press to show only this type, then repeat to restore all.

analysis.naluTypeCanvas.source: NALU 类型图。横轴为整片时间；放大查看逐帧类型。点击图例筛选类型，方向键选择，回车查看。
analysis.naluTypeCanvas.translation: NALU type chart. Horizontal axis: whole-source time; zoom in for per-frame types. Click legend to filter, arrow keys to select and Enter to inspect.

analysis.noLocatablePeak.source: 轨道 {slot}：该区间没有可定位的峰值样本。
analysis.noLocatablePeak.translation: Track {slot}: no locatable peak sample in this range.

analysis.noSampleAtTime.source: 轨道 {slot} 在该时间无可定位样本。
analysis.noSampleAtTime.translation: Track {slot} has no locatable sample at this time.

analysis.peakSeekFailed.source: 轨道 {slot}：峰值样本定位失败。

analysis.presentationLoadWindowHint.source: 展示负载率：按展示时间窗口统计帧的压缩字节量，不表示网络吞吐。
analysis.presentationLoadWindowHint.translation: Presentation load: compressed frame bytes within a presentation-time window; not network throughput.

analysis.qpLegendHint.source: 平均亮度 QP · 虚线；点击切换，右键或长按单选，再次操作恢复。
analysis.qpLegendHint.translation: Mean luma QP · dashed line; click to toggle, right-click or hold to solo, repeat to restore.

analysis.referenceCanvas.source: 帧参考关系图。横轴为整片时间；总览显示帧类型分布，放大后显示参考金字塔和连线。方向键选择，回车查看。
analysis.referenceCanvas.translation: Frame reference chart. Horizontal axis: whole-source time. Overview shows frame types; zoom in for reference pyramids and connections. Arrow keys select, Enter inspects.

analysis.referenceLegend.source: L0 实线 · L1 长虚线 · 点线指向视图外参考帧；活动参考列表不表示每个块都使用该参考帧。
analysis.referenceLegend.translation: Solid L0 · Long-dashed L1 · Dotted lines lead to offscreen reference frames; active lists do not mean every block uses every reference.

analysis.referenceOverview.source: 整片帧类型分布 · 放大查看参考金字塔与 L0 / L1 连线。
analysis.referenceOverview.translation: Whole-source frame type distribution · Zoom in for reference pyramids and L0 / L1 connections.

analysis.streamEmptyHint.source: 正在准备分析，NALU 和帧参考结果会自动显示。
analysis.streamEmptyHint.translation: Preparing analysis. NALU and frame reference results appear automatically.

analysis.streamLiveHint.source: 结果会随分析进度逐步显示。
analysis.streamLiveHint.translation: Results appear progressively as analysis proceeds.

analysis.streamWaiting.source: {slot} 等待索引 · 已检查 {count} 帧

analysis.temporalLayerHint.source: 层级来自图像 VCL NAL 的 Temporal ID。
analysis.temporalLayerHint.translation: Layer from the picture VCL NAL Temporal ID.

analysis.timeBaseTitle.source: PTS 为展示时间，DTS 为解码时间；无可靠 DTS 的轨道不支持 DTS 视图

connection.cantInstall.source: 无法安装或找不到证书？
connection.cantInstall.translation: Cannot install or find the certificate?

connection.cantInstallBody.source: 浏览器不能代替你安装系统证书。请确认已下载 voidplayer-ca.crt；如果设备由组织管理，请联系管理员部署。
connection.cantInstallBody.translation: The browser cannot install a system certificate for you. Make sure voidplayer-ca.crt is downloaded; on a managed device, ask your administrator to deploy it.

connection.certReady.source: 服务器已配置证书，请向管理员获取与证书匹配的 HTTPS 地址。
connection.certReady.translation: The server has a certificate. Ask your administrator for the matching HTTPS address.

connection.contactAdmin.source: 请联系管理员开启 HTTPS。
connection.contactAdmin.translation: Ask your administrator to enable HTTPS.

connection.defaultPorts.source: 默认 HTTPS 端口为 5180，证书引导页端口为 5181。已启用时，请使用管理员提供的引导地址。
connection.defaultPorts.translation: Default HTTPS port is 5180 and the certificate guide port is 5181. When enabled, use the guide address from your administrator.

connection.httpsOff.translation: The server has not enabled HTTPS.

connection.httpsUnavailable.translation: The server has not enabled HTTPS

connection.macRich1.source: 打开钥匙串访问，选中“登录”，通过“文件 → 导入项目”导入下载的证书。
connection.macRich1.translation: Open Keychain Access, select “login”, and import the downloaded certificate using “File → Import Items”.

connection.macRich2.source: 找到 VoidPlayer Local CA 证书，双击打开。
connection.macRich2.translation: Find the VoidPlayer Local CA certificate and double-click it.

connection.macRich3.source: 展开“信任”，将安全套接字层（SSL）设为“始终信任”。
connection.macRich3.translation: Expand “Trust” and set Secure Sockets Layer (SSL) to “Always Trust”.

connection.macStep4.source: 关闭窗口，按系统提示验证身份并保存。
connection.macStep4.translation: Close the window, verify your identity when prompted, and save.

connection.openPlayerHint.source: 安装完成后，点击“打开播放器”重新检查。
connection.openPlayerHint.translation: When done, click “Open the player” to recheck.

connection.ownCertHint.source: 此服务器使用自有证书。若浏览器仍提示证书问题，请联系管理员。
connection.ownCertHint.translation: This server uses its own certificate. If the browser still warns about certificates, contact your administrator.

connection.untrusted.source: 暂时无法建立可信的 HTTPS 连接。安装证书后可重新检查。
connection.untrusted.translation: Cannot establish a trusted HTTPS connection yet. Recheck after installing the certificate.

connection.verifyNote.source: 安装前，请与管理员核对服务器地址和证书指纹。
connection.verifyNote.translation: Before installing, confirm the server address and certificate fingerprint with your administrator.

connection.whyBody.source: 信任服务器证书后，浏览器可以建立可信的 HTTPS 连接，使用 WebCodecs 原生解码。实际硬件加速取决于浏览器、显卡和视频格式。
connection.whyBody.translation: Once you trust the server certificate, the browser can open a trusted HTTPS connection with native WebCodecs decoding. Actual hardware acceleration depends on the browser, GPU, and video format.

connection.winRich1.source: 双击下载的证书，选择安装证书。
connection.winRich1.translation: Double-click the downloaded certificate and select Install Certificate.

connection.winRich2.source: 选择当前用户，点击“下一步”。

connection.winRich3.source: 选择“将所有的证书都放入下列存储”，浏览并选中受信任的根证书颁发机构。
connection.winRich3.translation: Select “Place all certificates in the following store”, then browse to Trusted Root Certification Authorities.

connection.winStep4.source: 核对来源与指纹，按系统提示完成导入。
connection.winStep4.translation: Verify the source and fingerprint, then finish the import as prompted.

drawing.changed.source: 画面已变化，未将编辑写入其他帧。
drawing.changed.translation: The frame changed. Edits were not written to a different frame.

error.duplicateSource.translation: This source is already in the view and cannot be added again.

error.finishSeekFirst.translation: Finish seeking to a frame first.

error.pauseBeforeMark.source: 请暂停并等待画面定位完成后再标注。
error.pauseBeforeMark.translation: Pause playback and wait for frame positioning to finish before annotating.

error.referenceHdr.source: 此 HDR 视频未提供可核对的高位深平面。请切换为浏览器色彩后重试。
error.referenceHdr.translation: Managed color needs verifiable high-depth HDR planes. Switch to browser color and retry.

error.returnToMarkFrame.source: 请返回标注对应的画面后再编辑。
error.returnToMarkFrame.translation: Return to the annotated frame before editing.

error.trackNotSyncedForMark.source: 当前轨道尚未同步，请等待追赶完成或定位后再标注。
error.trackNotSyncedForMark.translation: The current track is not synchronized yet. Wait for it to catch up or seek before annotating.

error.waitColorMode.source: 请等待色彩模式切换完成。
error.waitColorMode.translation: Wait for the color mode switch to finish.

error.waitOperationBeforePlay.source: 请等待当前操作完成后再播放。

quality.actorChanged.translation: Actor changed. Reopen the attachment action.

quality.applies.source: 匹配此标注的锚点和区域

quality.attachTitle.source: 关联已完成的 PSNR 结果

quality.historical.source: 历史副本，本服务未核验
quality.historical.translation: Historical copy — not verified by this service

quality.notApplies.source: 历史证据：当前锚点或区域已不同

quality.openPair.translation: View original frame pair and ROI in a new window

quality.pairDisplay.translation: View two independent snapshots bound to the original cache, without rescoring. Display colors are converted by the presentation pipeline; PSNR measures source YUV code values, not screen pixels.

quality.pairLimits.source: 支持无裁剪、方形像素、无旋转的 FLV 闭合关键帧。缓存、版本、解码器或几何不匹配时不展示。
quality.pairLimits.translation: Supports uncropped, square-pixel, unrotated FLV closed key pictures. Source version, cache, decoder or geometry mismatches prevent display.

quality.pairReady.source: 两侧快照已按源、缓存、AU、实际 PTS 和几何核对；ROI 为只读覆盖层。
quality.pairReady.translation: Both snapshots match the source, cache, AU, actual PTS and geometry. ROI is a read-only overlay.

quality.pairTitle.translation: Original measurement frame pair and ROI

quality.privateUnavailable.source: 当前用户无法访问此已完成任务。
quality.privateUnavailable.translation: This completed job is unavailable to the current actor.

quality.score.source: PSNR {score} dB · 越高越好 · {depth} 位源 YUV 码值 · ROI {roi}
quality.score.translation: PSNR {score} dB · higher is better · {depth}-bit source YUV code values · ROI {roi}

quality.shareNotice.source: 此操作会向所有可查看该标注的人共享两侧片源身份、测量 ROI 和不可变结果事实。
quality.shareNotice.translation: This explicitly shares both source identities, measured ROI and immutable result facts with everyone who can view this annotation.

quality.target.source: 目标 {space}/{id} · 修订 {revision} · 源 PTS {pts} µs

quality.verified.source: 关联时已由来源服务核验
quality.verified.translation: Verified by the originating service at attachment

qualityWorkflow.attach.source: 将此结果显式共享到已有标注
qualityWorkflow.attach.translation: Explicitly share this result with an existing annotation

qualityWorkflow.attached.source: 已共享；以下链接使用标注中的不可变证据，查看器仍会重新核验来源、缓存和几何。
qualityWorkflow.attached.translation: Shared. These links use immutable annotation evidence; the viewer still revalidates sources, caches and geometry.

qualityWorkflow.available.source: 持久单帧 PSNR 可用；支持性仍按每个来源和执行结果判定。
qualityWorkflow.available.translation: Durable single-frame PSNR is available; eligibility is still determined per source and execution.

qualityWorkflow.budgets.source: 服务端资源计数与预算

qualityWorkflow.candidateNotice.source: 候选页只读取已有可信缓存，不构建索引。容器关键帧标记不保证可测；执行时仍逐侧核验闭合 AU、颜色、版本和缓存身份。缓存缺失请先在缓存管理中显式构建。
qualityWorkflow.candidateNotice.translation: Candidates only read existing trusted caches; they never build indexes. A container key flag does not guarantee eligibility. Execution still verifies each closed AU, color, version and cache identity. If missing, explicitly build the index in cache management first.

qualityWorkflow.capacity.source: 运行 {active}/{running}；排队 {queued}/{queueLimit}。容量由服务端统一管理。
qualityWorkflow.capacity.translation: Running {active}/{running}; queued {queued}/{queueLimit}. Capacity is managed by the service.

qualityWorkflow.confirmIdentity.source: 正在向服务确认当前用户…
qualityWorkflow.confirmIdentity.translation: Confirming the current user with the service…

qualityWorkflow.forget.source: 结束此提交的重试，准备新请求
qualityWorkflow.forget.translation: Stop retrying this submission; prepare a new request

qualityWorkflow.frame.source: 明确选择缓存 AU / 源 PTS

qualityWorkflow.geometryMismatch.source: 两侧需要相同的偶数可见尺寸；请明确选择有效 ROI。
qualityWorkflow.geometryMismatch.translation: Both sources need matching even visible dimensions; select an explicit valid ROI.

qualityWorkflow.history.source: 当前用户的服务端任务与历史
qualityWorkflow.history.translation: Current user’s service tasks and history

qualityWorkflow.identityUnconfirmed.source: 当前用户尚未由服务确认，请刷新页面重试。
qualityWorkflow.identityUnconfirmed.translation: The service has not confirmed the current user. Reload the page to try again.

qualityWorkflow.inspectable.source: 几何在原帧查看器支持范围内；执行与查看时仍重新核验。
qualityWorkflow.inspectable.translation: Geometry is in the original-pair viewer’s supported range; execution and viewing still revalidate it.

qualityWorkflow.invalidClient.source: 客户端 ID 须为 1–80 个字母、数字、点、下划线、冒号或连字符。
qualityWorkflow.invalidClient.translation: Client ID must contain 1–80 letters, digits, dots, underscores, colons or hyphens.

qualityWorkflow.invalidRoi.source: ROI 必须是两侧可见源网格内的偶数整数区域。
qualityWorkflow.invalidRoi.translation: ROI must be an even-integer region within both visible source grids.

qualityWorkflow.lifetime.source: 任务由服务持有。关闭此页或切换分类只停止观察；仅“取消任务”会请求终止。网络故障不表示任务失败。
qualityWorkflow.lifetime.translation: The service owns accepted jobs. Closing this page or changing sections only stops observation; only “Cancel task” requests termination. A network error does not mean a job failed.

qualityWorkflow.noVersion.source: 片源缺少版本，不能测量。
qualityWorkflow.noVersion.translation: The source has no version and cannot be measured.

qualityWorkflow.notInspectable.source: 此源可尝试测量，但原帧查看器拒绝此几何：{reason}
qualityWorkflow.notInspectable.translation: Measurement can be attempted, but the original-pair viewer rejects this geometry: {reason}

qualityWorkflow.observeError.source: 观察或请求暂不可用：{error}。任务终态以服务端事实为准。
qualityWorkflow.observeError.translation: Observation or request unavailable: {error}. Only service facts determine the task’s terminal state.

qualityWorkflow.observing.source: 正在观察当前用户的服务端事实；不需要播放器确认。
qualityWorkflow.observing.translation: Observing the current user’s service facts; no player acknowledgement is needed.

qualityWorkflow.pending.source: 提交结果尚未确认。请求已冻结；重试会复用原幂等键，不能据网络失败断言任务未创建。
qualityWorkflow.pending.translation: Submission outcome is not confirmed. The request is frozen; retries reuse the original idempotency key. A network error does not prove that no job was created.

qualityWorkflow.progress.source: 已评分 {pairs}/1 对；已解码帧 {frames}

qualityWorkflow.requestFacts.source: 请求、attempt 与服务端事实

qualityWorkflow.retry.translation: Retry submission with the original idempotency key

qualityWorkflow.roi.translation: ROI: unrotated visible source pixel grid; all values must be even integers

qualityWorkflow.scope.source: 显式配对两个媒体库闭合关键帧，以 8/10 位 YUV420 原始码值测量。不是截图评分，不自动按时间配对，也不支持普通依赖帧或序列。
qualityWorkflow.scope.translation: Explicitly pair two closed key pictures from the media library and measure 8/10-bit YUV420 source code values. This is not screenshot scoring, automatic time alignment, dependent-frame or sequence measurement.

qualityWorkflow.sourceProof.source: 来源、缓存身份与几何见证

qualityWorkflow.unavailable.source: 此实例不提供持久画质任务（例如临时数据库）。不会回退到浏览器临时计算。
qualityWorkflow.unavailable.translation: This instance does not offer durable quality jobs (for example, an in-memory database). No temporary browser computation is substituted.
